messages:
Erin (AE): Newbridge wants to migrate from EdgeModel -> Redwood. They requested a drop-in compatibility path, prompt parity for ~150 flows, security answers (SOC2/KMS/SAML), and pricing for hosted vs committed Dedicated. Can we scope a POC next week? Maya is on-thread.

Maya (Newbridge-Eng): Profile: ~2.5M tokens/mo, bursts up to 1.8k qps, heavy embeddings + rerank. EdgeModel uses /v2/generate and includes a top-level `trace` object in every response; stop-sequence handling is slightly different. Need parity for 150 canonical prompts and a deterministic mapping for response `id`/`epoch`. Also require 12mo log retention and EU data residency.

Jorge (SE): We can provide a compat proxy that rewrites EdgeModel request/response envelopes. Two options: lightweight proxy container or SDK adapter. For parity I need sample requests + EdgeModel outputs. I will run our parity harness `bin/parity_check` to produce per-prompt pass/fail and token-mismatch stats. ETA 72h after samples.

Maya (Newbridge-Eng): Uploading samples and 5 error-case examples (429, 500, 413, 401, slow 5s). Will include exact headers.

Nina (Security): I'll own the security questionnaire. Quick answers: SOC2 available on NDA/MSA; KMS options: Redwood-managed for hosted, customer-managed via Private/Dedicated. SAML supported. If they require HSM or SSE-C, recommend Private or Dedicated. Confirming EU-only logging support.

Ravi (CSM): Ballpark hosted cost @2.5M tokens ~= $2k/mo. Dedicated quote depends on chosen model and committed throughput; I'll draft a 12-mo committed estimate once parity results are in. Latency target they gave: p95 <250ms.

Jorge (SE): For p95 <250ms at spikes we recommend Dedicated + prefix KV caching + small batch windows. I can run a load test in the POC. The proxy can also map 413->422 and preserve `id` in top-level or mirror into `metadata.client_id`.

Erin (AE): Action items: Maya uploads samples and questionnaire link; Jorge builds proxy and runs parity; Nina completes security responses; Ravi prepares placeholder Dedicated estimate. I'll send NDA template so SOC2 can be shared.

DeployBot: Created POC bucket: s3://redwood-pocs/newbridge-1835004567 (retention 30d).

Maya (Newbridge-Eng): Samples uploaded, pinged the folder. Will review NDA.

Jorge (SE): :thumbsup: will post parity summary to this thread within 72h of samples.

Erin (AE): Thanks team  I'll block time Friday to review results and finalize quote.
